signOut.body: You'll be signed out on this device. Appearance and language stay as they are.

appearance.intro: Choose how SPEED CLUB looks. Your choice applies right away.
appearance.offline: Offline – your choice still applies right away on this device.
appearance.noteSynced: Applies on this device and is saved to your account.
appearance.noteDevice: Your choice applies on this device. When you are signed in, we also save it to your account.

legal.title: Legal
legal.offlineBanner: Offline – you're seeing the list as last loaded.
legal.offlineCached: Offline – you're seeing the version last loaded.

legal.offlineListBody: The list isn't on your device yet. We'll load it once you're back online.

blocked.title: Blocked accounts
blocked.intro: Blocked members can't see your profile or vehicles and can't message you. You can't see theirs either.
blocked.confirmBody: {{name}} will be able to see your profile and vehicles again and follow you. Previous follows aren't restored.
blocked.emptyBody: Anyone you block shows up here. You can unblock them at any time.
blocked.offlineBody: The list isn't on your device yet. We'll load it as soon as you're back online.
blocked.offlineBanner: Offline – you're seeing the list as it was last loaded.

offlineForm: Offline – you can save once you're back online.

common.serverError: That didn't work. Please try again in a moment.
common.offlineBody: We'll load the page as soon as you're back online.

restricted.body: Your account is restricted. Settings, data export and account deletion still work.
restricted.until: Your account is restricted until {{date}}. Settings, data export and account deletion still work.
restricted.supportBody: Your account is restricted. You can still contact support, also about the restriction.

validation.emailInvalid: This email address doesn't look complete.
validation.emailUnchanged: That's already your address. Enter a different one.
validation.passwordLength: The password needs at least 10 characters.
validation.passwordTooLong: The password can have at most 255 characters.
validation.passwordSameAsEmail: The password can't be your email address.
validation.passwordUnchanged: The new password is the same as the old one.
validation.codeRequired: Enter the code from your app or a recovery code.
validation.codeOrRecoveryInvalid: That's neither a 6-digit code nor a recovery code.
validation.understoodRequired: Confirm that you understand what will happen.
validation.subjectTooLong: The subject can have at most 120 characters.
validation.messageTooShort: Write a few more words so we can help.
validation.messageTooLong: The message can have at most 5,000 characters.
validation.recoveryInvalid: That doesn't look like a recovery code.
validation.replyTooShort: Your reply needs at least two characters.

reauth.code: Code from your app or recovery code
reauth.codeHelper: 6 digits from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
reauth.codeNeeded: Two-factor protection is on for your account. Enter a code as well.
reauth.locked: Too many wrong codes. The two-factor check is locked until you reset your password under “Forgot password” with a code by email. You stay signed in.

email.title: Change email address
email.intro: You currently sign in with {{email}}. We'll send a code to the new address. We only change it once you enter that code.
email.passwordHelper: So nobody can change your address on an unlocked device.
email.sentTo: If {{email}} can be used, a 6-digit code will arrive there shortly.
email.codeHint: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
email.invalidCode: This code is wrong or has expired.
email.changed: Your email address has been changed. The old address gets a notice.

password.title: Change password
password.revokeOthersHelper: Every other device and browser has to sign in with the new password. This device stays signed in.
password.changedOthersOut: Your password has been changed. Other devices are signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor protection
twoFactor.intro: With two-factor protection, you need your password and a 6-digit code from an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Aegis, to sign in. Someone who only knows your password can't get into your account.
twoFactor.statusOnBody: Every time you sign in, you need a code from your app.
twoFactor.statusOffBody: Your password is enough to sign in.
twoFactor.startBody: Confirm with your password that it's you.
twoFactor.scanTitle: 1. Add the account to your app
twoFactor.scanBody: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app. On this device you can also copy the key and paste it into the app.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.copyFailed: Copying didn't work. Select the text and copy it yourself.
twoFactor.noApp: No matching app found. Scan the QR code or copy the key.
twoFactor.invalidCode: This code is wrong. Enter the current code from the app.
twoFactor.codesBody: We only show you these codes this one time. If you can't access your authenticator app, you sign in with one of them. Each code works exactly once. Keep them somewhere safe, such as your password manager or on paper.
twoFactor.downloadFailed: The file couldn't be saved. Copy the codes instead.
twoFactor.codesFileUsage: Each code works exactly once. Use it when signing in instead of the code from your app. Keep this file somewhere safe.
twoFactor.newCodesBody: Your current codes will stop working, and we'll only show the new ones once. Confirm with your password and a code.
twoFactor.turnOffBody: Confirm with your password and a code from your app or a recovery code.
twoFactor.turnOffDialogBody: Your password will be enough to sign in. Your recovery codes stop working.

sessions.title: Devices & sessions
sessions.intro: You're signed in on these devices. We store the device, system, app version and last use, but no IP address and no location. If you don't recognise a device, sign it out and change your password.
sessions.onlyThis: You're only signed in on this device.
sessions.confirmOneBody: You'll have to sign in again on that device. Push notifications stop arriving there.
sessions.confirmOthersBody_one: The other device will have to sign in again. This device stays signed in.
sessions.confirmOthersBody_other: The {{count}} other devices will have to sign in again. This device stays signed in.
sessions.signedOutOthers: All other devices are signed out
sessions.emptyBody: Once you're signed in, your devices show up here.
sessions.offlineBanner: Offline – signing out devices works once you're back online.

privacy.title: Privacy & contact

who.everyoneHelper: Every member can message you. Messages from people you don't follow land in your requests first.
who.followingHelper: Only people you follow can start a new conversation.
who.nobodyHelper: Nobody can start a new conversation. Ongoing conversations stay.

privacy.discoverableHelper: Off: you don't appear in search, in “Active members” or in suggestions. Your profile stays reachable through a link.
privacy.indexableHelper: Off: search engines are asked not to list your profile and vehicle pages, and we remove them from our sitemap at once. Existing results disappear when the search engine visits the page again.
privacy.ownerOnQr: Show owner on the QR page
privacy.ownerOnQrHelper: Off: your name isn't shown on your vehicle pages, in feeds or on new sticker PDFs. Only you see it.
privacy.readReceiptsHelper: Off: others don't see when you've read their messages.
privacy.offlineNote: You can't change these settings while offline.
privacy.offlineBanner: Offline – you're seeing the settings as last loaded.
privacy.aiSuggestionsHelper: Suggestions for search, mod details, photo categories and your vehicle description, each marked “AI suggestion”. You decide what to use. For this, the text or photo goes to our AI provider Anthropic as a processor (details in the privacy policy). You start each translation yourself.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.webNote: Browsers don't get push notifications. These switches apply to the app on your phone.

types.message_requestHelper: When someone you don't follow messages you.
types.followed_publishedHelper: When members you follow publish a vehicle or an update.
types.build_savedHelper: Once a week: how often your builds were saved, never by whom.

notifications.previewsHelper: Off: the notification only says there's a message. On: the text passes through Apple, Google and Expo.
notifications.quietHelper: No push notifications during this time; everything is still in the app. Moderation decisions always come through. Times are in German time.
notifications.digestHelper: An email when a message has been unread for more than 12 hours.
notifications.mandatory: Security notices (new device, password, email, two-factor, deletion) and moderation decisions always reach you by email.
notifications.offlineBanner: Offline – you're seeing the settings as last loaded.

language.title: Language & units
language.metricNote: Everything else is metric: Nm, mm, cm³.
language.offlineBanner: Offline – you can still change the language.

export.title: Export my data
export.intro: You get a ZIP file with everything you've stored on SPEED CLUB. We put it together in the background, usually within a few minutes, and then email you a link. The link is valid for 7 days. You can request one export every 24 hours.

contents.vehicles: Vehicles with specs, mods and history
contents.social: Who you follow, who follows you, blocks and saved builds
contents.photos: All your photos at full size

export.notIncluded: Other members only appear with their username. The export contains no IP addresses.
export.reauthBody: Confirm with your password. We'll send the link to your account's email address.
export.requested: Export requested. You'll get an email as soon as it's ready.
export.tooSoon: You've already requested an export in the last 24 hours. Please try again later.
export.tooSoonIn: You've already requested an export in the last 24 hours. The next one is possible in {{time}}.
export.workingDetail: We're putting the file together. You'll get an email.
export.readyUntil: The link in the email is valid until {{date}}.
export.expiredDetail: The link has expired and the file is deleted.
export.failedDetail: The export didn't work. Request it again.
export.none: You haven't requested an export yet.
export.offlineBanner: Offline – you can request an export once you're back online.
export.retentionNote: Your export stays available for up to 7 days.
export.unavailableBody: We can’t create an export right now. Please try again later.
export.unavailableBodyIn: We can’t create an export right now. Please try again in {{time}}.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: Before you delete your account: this is what happens as soon as you confirm.

consequences.hidden: Right away: your profile and all your vehicles are no longer visible to anyone.
consequences.stickers: Right away: your QR stickers no longer lead to your vehicles. Anyone who scans them sees that the code is no longer active.
consequences.signedOut: Right away: you're signed out on every device and can't sign in again.
consequences.social: Right away: your follows and followers are removed.
consequences.messages: People you've messaged keep the conversation. Instead of your name, it then shows “Deleted member”.
consequences.final: Within 30 days we permanently delete your account, your photos and all other data.
consequences.noUndo: This can't be undone, not even within the 30 days. If you want to come back, create a new account.

delete.exportFirst: Want to keep your data? Request an export first.
delete.retention: What we have to keep longer for legal reasons is listed in the privacy policy.
delete.understood: I understand that my account is deactivated right away and permanently deleted within 30 days.
delete.codeNeeded: Two-factor protection is on for your account. Enter a code as well.
delete.dialogBody: Your account is deactivated right away and deleted within 30 days. This can't be undone.
delete.webHint: You can also do this in a browser, without the app.
delete.exportKept: An export you request beforehand stays available for up to 7 days, even after the deletion.

deleted.title: Your account is deactivated
deleted.body: You're signed out. Your profile and vehicles are no longer visible, and your QR codes no longer work. Within 30 days we permanently delete your data.
deleted.mail: We've sent you a confirmation by email.
deleted.export: Did you request an export beforehand? The link in the email works for up to 7 days.

help.contactHint: You’ll get the reply here in the app.

contact.title: Contact support
contact.intro: Tell us what we can help with. You’ll find our reply under “Your requests”, and we’ll send you a notification.
contact.subject: Subject
contact.privacyNote: Please don't put passwords or codes in the message. We only use your details to reply to you.
contact.sent: Thanks, we’ve received your message. You’ll find the reply under “Your requests”.

consent.title: We’ve updated our terms
consent.intro: Before you carry on, take a quick look at what changed and agree to the new version.
consent.noSummary: You’ll find the changes in the new version.
consent.declineBody: Without your agreement you can’t keep using SPEED CLUB, so we’ll sign you out. Your account and your builds stay, and you can agree the next time you sign in.
consent.outdated: A newer version has just come out. Please read it and agree again.
consent.network: No connection. Your agreement isn’t saved yet, try again in a moment.
consent.failed: That didn’t work just now. Try again in a moment.
consent.offline: You need a connection to agree.
consent.loadFailed: We could not load the updated terms just now. Before you carry on, we need your consent.
consent.loadOffline: You are offline. As soon as you are back online, we will show you the updated terms.

requests.rowHint: The team’s replies and where your requests stand
requests.emptyBody: When you write to the team, you’ll find your request and the replies here.
requests.offlineBody: We’ll load your requests as soon as you’re back online.
requests.offlineBanner: Offline – your requests load once you’re online.
requests.goneBody: This request doesn’t exist or belongs to another account.

reply.title: Reply
reply.label: Your reply
reply.hint: Your message goes to the team in this request. You’ll find the reply here, and we’ll send you a notification.
reply.closedHint: This request is closed. If you write again, we will reopen it.
reply.sent: Reply sent. The request is open again.
